name: schedule
text: The data: what is exported to MSPDI, and what GRS adds to draw it.

name: schedule.project
text: Same as MSPDI Project.

name: schedule.calendars
shape: array, optional: omit the property when there are no items; never write [] (minItems 1)
text: Same as MSPDI Calendars.

name: schedule.tasks
shape: array, optional: omit the property when there are no items; never write [] (minItems 1)
text: Same as MSPDI Tasks, except that the WBS tree is given by Task.parentTaskUid and Task.siblingOrder.

name: schedule.resources
shape: array, optional: omit the property when there are no items; never write [] (minItems 1)
text: Same as MSPDI Resources.

name: schedule.assignments
shape: array, optional: omit the property when there are no items; never write [] (minItems 1)
text: Same as MSPDI Assignments.

name: Project
text: Same as MSPDI Project.

name: Project.id
text: Same as MSPDI Project/UID. GRS does not use it as a key.

name: Project.calendarUid
text: Same as MSPDI Project/CalendarUID. GRS counts all working days with this one calendar.

name: Project.name
text: Same as MSPDI Project/Name. GRS does not show it; the name shown on screen is title.

name: Project.title
text: Same as MSPDI Project/Title. GRS shows it at the top of the page and uses it as the default name of an exported file. Absent shows Untitled.

name: Project.subject
text: Same as MSPDI Project/Subject.

name: Project.category
text: Same as MSPDI Project/Category.

name: Project.company
text: Same as MSPDI Project/Company.

name: Project.manager
text: Same as MSPDI Project/Manager.

name: Project.author
text: Same as MSPDI Project/Author. It is not who wrote the document last (documentStamp.lastEditedBy).

name: Project.revision
text: Same as MSPDI Project/Revision. It is not one of the documentStamp times.

name: Project.creationDate
text: Same as MSPDI Project/CreationDate. GRS writes it when it makes a new document.

name: Project.startDate
text: Same as MSPDI Project/StartDate.

name: Project.statusDate
text: Same as MSPDI Project/StatusDate. GRS draws the status line on its day. Absent means no status line, and Delay Diagnostics does not run.

name: Project.scheduleDataTimeZone
text: The fixed UTC offset that the schedule date-times are given in, written as a standard-time key such as UTC+09:00. Daylight saving is never applied. It is not written to MSPDI.

name: Project.minutesPerDay
text: Same as MSPDI Project/MinutesPerDay. 480 when absent. Keep it equal to the working minutes of every working day; when a day differs, GRS reports it each time the document opens.

name: Project.minutesPerWeek
text: Same as MSPDI Project/MinutesPerWeek.

name: Project.daysPerMonth
text: Same as MSPDI Project/DaysPerMonth.

name: Project.weekStartDay
text: Same as MSPDI Project/WeekStartDay. Absent means Monday (1).

name: Project.defaultStartTime
text: Same as MSPDI Project/DefaultStartTime. GRS writes this time on start-side dates; 08:00:00 when absent.

name: Project.defaultFinishTime
text: Same as MSPDI Project/DefaultFinishTime. GRS writes this time on finish-side dates; 17:00:00 when absent.

name: Project.passthroughValues
shape: PassthroughValues (map str->str<=65535, >=1 entry), optional (not in required); when the property is absent: nothing kept
text: MSPDI values that GRS does not read, kept and written back unchanged. Absent when there are none.

name: Project.passthroughElements
shape: PassthroughElement[], optional: omit the property when there are no items; never write [] (minItems 1)
text: MSPDI elements that GRS does not read, kept and written back unchanged. Absent when there are none.

name: Calendar
text: Same as MSPDI Calendar.

name: Calendar.uid
text: Same as MSPDI Calendar/UID.

name: Calendar.baseCalendarUid
text: Same as MSPDI Calendar/BaseCalendarUID.

name: Calendar.name
text: Same as MSPDI Calendar/Name.

name: Calendar.isBaseCalendar
text: Same as MSPDI Calendar/IsBaseCalendar. Absent reads as false.

name: Calendar.weekDays
shape: WeekDay[], optional: omit the property when there are no items; never write [] (minItems 1)
text: Same as MSPDI Calendar/WeekDays.

name: Calendar.exceptions
shape: Exception[], optional: omit the property when there are no items; never write [] (minItems 1)
text: Same as MSPDI Calendar/Exceptions.

name: Calendar.passthroughValues
shape: PassthroughValues (map str->str<=65535, >=1 entry), optional (not in required); when the property is absent: nothing kept
text: MSPDI values that GRS does not read, kept and written back unchanged. Absent when there are none.

name: Calendar.passthroughElements
shape: PassthroughElement[], optional: omit the property when there are no items; never write [] (minItems 1)
text: MSPDI elements that GRS does not read, kept and written back unchanged. Absent when there are none.

name: WeekDay
text: Same as MSPDI WeekDay.

name: WeekDay.dayType
text: Same as MSPDI WeekDay/DayType, except that 0 is not used: exception days are held in Exception.

name: WeekDay.dayWorking
text: Same as MSPDI WeekDay/DayWorking. Absent reads as not working.

name: WeekDay.workingTimes
shape: WorkingTime[] 1..5, optional: omit the property when there are no items; never write [] (minItems 1)
text: Same as MSPDI WeekDay/WorkingTimes. Absent on a working day means the default spans 08:00-12:00, 13:00-17:00.

name: WeekDay.passthroughValues
shape: PassthroughValues (map str->str<=65535, >=1 entry), optional (not in required); when the property is absent: nothing kept
text: MSPDI values that GRS does not read, kept and written back unchanged. Absent when there are none.

name: WeekDay.passthroughElements
shape: PassthroughElement[], optional: omit the property when there are no items; never write [] (minItems 1)
text: MSPDI elements that GRS does not read, kept and written back unchanged. Absent when there are none.

name: Exception
text: Same as MSPDI Exception.

name: Exception.name
text: Same as MSPDI Exception/Name.

name: Exception.fromDate
text: Same as MSPDI TimePeriod/FromDate.

name: Exception.toDate
text: Same as MSPDI TimePeriod/ToDate.

name: Exception.dayWorking
text: Same as MSPDI Exception/DayWorking. Absent reads as not working.

name: Exception.recurrenceKind
text: Same as MSPDI Exception/Type. GRS counts only a one-off exception: 9, absent, or 1 with recurrencePeriod absent or 1. It keeps any other exception but does not count it. Write 1 for an exception you add.

name: Exception.recurrencePeriod
shape: int >=1, optional (not in required); when the property is absent: the file had no Period
text: Same as MSPDI Exception/Period.

name: Exception.workingTimes
shape: WorkingTime[] 1..5, optional: omit the property when there are no items; never write [] (minItems 1)
text: Same as MSPDI Exception/WorkingTimes. Absent on a working day means the default spans 08:00-12:00, 13:00-17:00.

name: Exception.passthroughValues
shape: PassthroughValues (map str->str<=65535, >=1 entry), optional (not in required); when the property is absent: nothing kept
text: MSPDI values that GRS does not read, kept and written back unchanged. Absent when there are none.

name: Exception.passthroughElements
shape: PassthroughElement[], optional: omit the property when there are no items; never write [] (minItems 1)
text: MSPDI elements that GRS does not read, kept and written back unchanged. Absent when there are none.

name: WorkingTime
text: Same as MSPDI WorkingTime. GRS refuses spans of one day that overlap or do not start before they end; spans that only touch, such as one ending at 12:00 and one starting at 12:00, are fine.

name: WorkingTime.fromTime
text: Same as MSPDI WorkingTime/FromTime.

name: WorkingTime.toTime
text: Same as MSPDI WorkingTime/ToTime: 00:00:00 is the end of the day.

name: Task
text: Same as MSPDI Task.

name: Task.uid
text: Same as MSPDI Task/UID.

name: Task.calendarUid
text: Same as MSPDI Task/CalendarUID. GRS keeps it only to write it back; working days are counted with project.calendarUid.

name: Task.name
text: Same as MSPDI Task/Name.

name: Task.notes
text: Same as MSPDI Task/Notes.

name: Task.start
text: Same as MSPDI Task/Start.

name: Task.finish
text: Same as MSPDI Task/Finish.

name: Task.milestone
text: Same as MSPDI Task/Milestone. Absent reads as false. When true, TaskVisual holds milestoneShape; otherwise it holds taskShape.

name: Task.deadline
text: Same as MSPDI Task/Deadline.

name: Task.actualStart
text: Same as MSPDI Task/ActualStart.

name: Task.stop
text: Same as MSPDI Task/Stop. GRS omits it once actualFinish is set.

name: Task.actualFinish
text: Same as MSPDI Task/ActualFinish.

name: Task.resume
text: Same as MSPDI Task/Resume.

name: Task.resumeValid
text: Same as MSPDI Task/ResumeValid. GRS reads false as an interruption with no restart day decided.

name: Task.percentComplete
text: Same as MSPDI Task/PercentComplete, but GRS works it out again from the dates each time it reads a GRS JSON file: round(actual length / planned length x 100) in working minutes, the actual length running from actualStart to actualFinish, or to stop. It can be above 100; a milestone is 100 once actualFinish is set, otherwise 0.

name: Task.fadeInCalendarDays
shape: int >=0, optional (not in required); when the property is absent: no fade: default depth on chevrons; 0 = flat end
text: Calendar days at the start of the bar drawn slanted, to show that the start is not yet firm; absent means no fade, and 0 means a flat end. Written to MSPDI as a Task/ExtendedAttribute.

name: Task.fadeOutCalendarDays
shape: int >=0, optional (not in required); when the property is absent: no fade: default depth on chevrons; 0 = flat end
text: As fadeInCalendarDays, for the finish. Written to MSPDI as a Task/ExtendedAttribute.

name: Task.hyperlinkAddress
shape: str 1..512 (URL), optional (not in required); when the property is absent: no link
text: Same as MSPDI Task/HyperlinkAddress.

name: Task.hyperlink
shape: str 1..512 (link title), optional (not in required); when the property is absent: no link title
text: Same as MSPDI Task/Hyperlink: the title of the link, not its address.

name: Task.dependencies
shape: Dependency[], optional: omit the property when there are no items; never write [] (minItems 1)
text: Same as MSPDI Task/PredecessorLink.

name: Task.passthroughValues
shape: PassthroughValues (map str->str<=65535, >=1 entry), optional (not in required); when the property is absent: nothing kept
text: MSPDI values that GRS does not read, kept and written back unchanged. Absent when there are none.

name: Task.passthroughElements
shape: PassthroughElement[], optional: omit the property when there are no items; never write [] (minItems 1)
text: MSPDI elements that GRS does not read, kept and written back unchanged. Absent when there are none.

name: Dependency
text: Same as MSPDI PredecessorLink.

name: Dependency.predecessorUid
text: Same as MSPDI PredecessorLink/PredecessorUID.

name: Dependency.linkType
text: Same as MSPDI PredecessorLink/Type.

name: Dependency.linkLag
text: Same as MSPDI PredecessorLink/LinkLag. When project.minutesPerDay is absent, a working day is 480 minutes.

name: Dependency.lagFormat
text: Same as MSPDI PredecessorLink/LagFormat. GRS counts only 7 (working days), 5 (hours) and 3 (minutes); it keeps any other value but does not count the lag. GRS writes the unit that the lag was typed in.

name: Dependency.passthroughValues
shape: PassthroughValues (map str->str<=65535, >=1 entry), optional (not in required); when the property is absent: nothing kept
text: MSPDI values that GRS does not read, kept and written back unchanged. Absent when there are none.

name: Dependency.passthroughElements
shape: PassthroughElement[], optional: omit the property when there are no items; never write [] (minItems 1)
text: MSPDI elements that GRS does not read, kept and written back unchanged. Absent when there are none.

name: Resource.calendarUid
text: Same as MSPDI Resource/CalendarUID. GRS keeps it only to write it back; working days are counted with project.calendarUid.

name: Resource.name
text: Same as MSPDI Resource/Name.

name: Resource.resourceKind
text: Same as MSPDI Resource/Type.

name: Resource.isCostResource
text: Same as MSPDI Resource/IsCostResource. Absent reads as false.

text: Same as MSPDI Assignment/UID.

name: Assignment.taskUid
text: Same as MSPDI Assignment/TaskUID.

name: Assignment.resourceUid
text: Same as MSPDI Assignment/ResourceUID.

name: Assignment.passthroughValues
shape: PassthroughValues (map str->str<=65535, >=1 entry), optional (not in required); when the property is absent: nothing kept
text: MSPDI values that GRS does not read, kept and written back unchanged. Absent when there are none.

text: MSPDI elements that GRS does not read, kept and written back unchanged. Absent when there are none.

name: PassthroughValues
text: MSPDI values that GRS does not read, kept under their MSPDI names and written back unchanged.

name: PassthroughElement
text: One MSPDI element that GRS does not read, kept and written back unchanged in its place.

name: PassthroughElement.name
text: The element name in the MSPDI file, spelled exactly as it came.

name: DateTime
text: A wall-clock date-time in project.scheduleDataTimeZone, written without an offset, as MSPDI writes it; an offset in an imported file is dropped.

name: Time
text: A time of day, as MSPDI writes it.
